ember_mill.title: The Ember Mill
ember_mill.description: Elsa Rook's mill has burned for seven nights without being consumed. She believes the Ash Warden beneath it is keeping the fire alive and wants the creature ended.
ember_mill.objective: Defeat the Ash Warden in the Ember Vault beneath the mill.

mill_ledger.title: The Miller's Ledger
mill_ledger.description: Brother Cael needs the mill's ledger to learn which families paid the Ash Covenant, and which were marked for the fire.
mill_ledger.objective: Recover the Mill Ledger from the Ember Vault and return it to Brother Cael.

ash_bargain.title: The Ash Bargain
ash_bargain.description: The Ember Seal was the miller's promise to the thing under the floor. Elsa wants it back before the Covenant can use it to wake the furnace again.
ash_bargain.objective: Recover the Ember Seal from the Ember Vault and return it to Elsa Rook.
